remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 3 bedroom, 3 full, 2 half Bathroom masterpiece located within walking distance to New Canaan's favorite restaurants, shops and train station. Built with the best finishes in mind, this 3,800 sq ft home features a flexible open floor plan, Elevator, private office, large-pane oversized windows, formal rooms that flow seamlessly from one to another, and the ultimate dream kitchen featuring a gorgeous island with 2" countertops, chefs appliances and custom walk-in pantry. Enjoy the gorgeous family room with gas fireplace and 15 ft sliders that open up to your private terrace overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with dual closets and spa inspired bathroom that will take your breath away featuring a 10ft x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, 8ft floating vanity, and heated floors. (All bedrooms have en-sutie bathrooms). Gorgeous mudroom with elevator that travels from bedroom level to the finished walkout basement. Additional features include Spray foam and sound proofing insulation, irrigation system, Hydro HVAC system, and more. Too many features to list.
